Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: 60-90m ML/Infra deep-dive for IntelliFarm

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call today — good clarity on the primary goals (batch inference at edge, model delta testing, and cost targets). Per our agreed next step, we'd like to lock a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/Infra team to walk through architecture, performance expectations, and a short runbook for an initial pilot.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Jul 6, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jul 7, 13:00–14:30
- Fri Jul 9, 09:00–10:30

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m - goals & success criteria (your team)
2) 20m - IntelliFarm environment & constraints (you)
3) 35m - Redwood architecture & recommended config (Marissa + Mateo)
4) 15–30m - Q&A + next actions / pilot plan

Ask: could you confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (esp. infra/edge ops + ML lead)? Also sharing a short prep packet (prelim-tdx-agenda.pdf, intellifarm-env-overview.pdf) — please drop any additional items you want covered.

If none of those times work, send two alternative slots and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: prelim-tdx-agenda.pdf, intellifarm-env-overview.pdf

Hi Monica —

Appreciate the recap and the draft agenda — this is exactly what we had in mind. Attendees from our side: me (Head of ML), Diego Ramos (Edge Ops), and Priya Shah (Platform/Cloud). We also want our security lead (Amit Chopra) to join the first 30 minutes to confirm compliance questions.

Best slots for us: Wed Jul 7, 13:00–14:30 works great. If you can make it 90 minutes, that would be ideal so we have time for a short run of our example request pattern.

We'll upload a short network/egress summary and a small sample trace file to the shared folder by end of day.

—Sara
